metadata.description: Grouping for `skills add lumirelle/skills`: skills meant to live on your machine only are listed under `private`, everything else falls to the CLI's `Other` bucket so it gets installed and configured per project.

plugins.name: private
plugins.description: Private skills: install once on this machine, share with nobody. They act on the person, not on the repo you happen to be in, so they are never part of a project's shared tooling.
